name: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio
how_you_get_it: Open a Model Studio account. Each model carries its own free grant.
trap: The grant is per model, not per account, and each one runs its own 90-day clock that does not pause. The leftover voids.

balance.why_not_api: GET /api/v1/models lists the catalog with no free-quota field and GET /api/v1/quotas returns rate limits, not the remaining grant. Measured 2026-08-21.

coverage.what: the models with a free grant
coverage.note: each model has its own 90-day grant; the remainder is only on the console.
